title: Flipping a coordinate outside a block offset
statement: Let $w,s$ be natural numbers, let $i$ index one of the $sw$ coordinates, and let $x$ be a sign vector of length $sw$. If an offset $o$ among the $w$ positions differs from the within-block coordinate of $i$, then flipping coordinate $i$ leaves unchanged the value of $x$ at offset $o$ in the block containing $i$.
